page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests show average throughput, reaching 75.3 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, though Passmark memory scores are positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given its high memory density and average multi-threaded capabilities, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints without demanding extreme single-thread compute performance. It is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded tasks like software compilation. It is less optimal for single-threaded processing or heavy local storage I/O due to the lack of bundled local SSDs.
